name: SOL fair-value protected maker
description: Rests post-only quotes on both sides of KXSOL15M between 600 s and 120 s to close, each at least `margin` cents better than a spot-vol fair value (Phi of spot-minus-strike over 15-minute realized vol), re-priced every 15 s. Generalises sol-zfav-maker from confirmed favourites to every z, with the margin as protection against adverse selection.
hypothesis: sol-zfav-maker earns about +1.3c as a maker on |z|>=1.5 favourites, so resting quotes priced off a spot fair value should earn the margin whenever a slower or less informed taker hits them. Wrong if fills are adversely selected (the maker tests spreadmk, volfav-maker, dog-seller lost 0.5-2c) so that PnL per contract stays <= 0 at margins of 1-3c, or the fill rate collapses at large margins.
next: ad hoc dev windows, then smoke/quick
